display_long_description:
Epic space battles start with ships and weapons you build 🚀💥🥇

BuildPort Xumia is a physics based social combat sandbox where creativity and skill shape every battle.

Build your own spaceships and hand weapons, pilot them into combat, battle on foot, defend against waves of enemies, or challenge other players in PvP. Every creation is yours, and every match is different.

- Build unique spaceships and hand weapons
- Battle in PvP, Co-op, and Core Siege
- Fly through the Rift and master your skills
- Build with friends in Social BuildPort
- Climb the leaderboards and prove yourself

Every build is unique. Every victory is earned. 

[media]

Build. Battle. Go Solo or Team up.

Whether you enjoy creating, competing, or simply hanging out with friends, BuildPort Xumia gives you the freedom to play your own way.

[media]

NEW Update: Level Up!

The biggest update yet brings progression, customization, smoother movement, and even more ways to play together.

**Progression System**

- Complete quests and earn XP
- Unlock new rewards as you level up
- Keep progressing every time you play

Expanded Customization

- Unlock color palettes
- Customize your ships and hand weapons
- Show off your own style

[media]

More Ways to Play

- Auto Match is back, making it easier to jump into multiplayer
- New hybrid movement with smooth continuous locomotion
- Hand gizmos can now eliminate other players in multiplayer
- Throw fun objects at your friends for even more chaos

Create. Fight. Level Up.
